name: Gabor Nemeth
office: Palos Verdes Library District, Member, Board of Trustees

items.text: Gabor Nemeth's ballot designation is small business owner. He is a Peninsula High School graduate, University of Redlands alumnus, and school volunteer. His campaign site says he would protect library services, expand technology and digital access, and partner with schools and community groups. He stresses fiscal accountability and transparent budgeting.
